about: Who narrates explainer clips. A clip names its map zone (the island ids in game/ui/map.gd, plus foundations) and is narrated by that zone's tutor; recordings go in game/assets/audio/voice/<tutor>/clips/<clip id>/. Tutors are the regional cast from GitHub issue #18, not the story characters (Spark, Gear Mira, Dax, Noma). Every entry here is that issue's starting proposal and none is approved: casting, names and accents are decided on #18. When a tutor is approved, set status to 'approved' and fill in sheet and brief. Nothing may be recorded for a clip until its tutor is approved.

tin-can-tess.name: Tin-Can Tess
tin-can-tess.direction: Scrapyard mechanic. Female, lively Australian English, wry, approachable.

mags-the-ledger.name: Mags the Ledger
mags-the-ledger.direction: Wasteland trader who treats equations as negotiations. Female, rugged outback Australian English, quick-witted, commanding.

rook-dead-air.name: Rook Dead-Air
rook-dead-air.direction: Communications engineer: inputs, outputs, unstable transmissions. Male, South African English influence, precise but increasingly excitable.

kara-meridian.name: Kara Meridian
kara-meridian.direction: Desert surveyor with homemade instruments. Female, southern African English, measured, confident.

lucky-lenoir.name: Lucien "Lucky" Lenoir
lucky-lenoir.direction: Charming gamesmaster who keeps losing to probability. Male, French-accented English, theatrical but intelligible.

calc.name: C.A.L.C.
calc.direction: Damaged reactor-maintenance AI obsessed with rates of change. Synthetic voice, expressive glitching.
